llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注髋臼骨折的手术治疗，未涉及股骨柄假体的应力遮挡或微动分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on surgical treatment of acetabular fractures with ORIF and THA, not on femoral stem stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 探讨切开复位内固定联合全髋关节置换治疗骨质疏松性髋臼骨折的效果
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析接受联合手术的患者临床资料
summary_zh.result: 联合手术可有效恢复髋臼稳定性和关节功能

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the clinical outcomes of simultaneous open reduction and internal fixation combined with total hip arthroplasty for osteoporotic acetabular fractures.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of patient data undergoing the combined procedure.
summary_en.result: The combined approach effectively restored acetabular stability and joint function.
summary_en.validation: Clinical case series without biomechanical testing.
